no-restricted-syntax.message: Use a token from @variegated-coffee/ui instead of a hex colour. This frontend had 736 of these and two blues in service at once; tokens.color, tokens.pen and tokens.phase are the palette. If a role is genuinely missing, add it there rather than reaching past it here.
Use a token from @variegated-coffee/ui instead of a hex colour, even inside a template string.

Use TextInput's `numeric` prop rather than type="number". A number input is rendered and parsed in the *browser's* locale, so a PID gain of 1.4 displays as 1,4 on a machine in a comma locale -- on a field the firmware then parses. Integer-only fields with a two-digit range are the one exception; add an eslint-disable with that reasoning.
Use tokens.font.mono. The bare literal loses the fallback stack the token carries.

no-restricted-globals.name: confirm
no-restricted-globals.message: Use useDialogs().confirm from @variegated-coffee/ui. window.confirm is unstyled, untranslatable, and suppressible per-origin by the browser -- so a delete can proceed unconfirmed.

no-restricted-globals.name: alert
no-restricted-globals.message: Use useDialogs().notify, or an Alert where the message belongs on the page.
